findings.evidence: `Mathlib/Topology/Algebra/OpenSubgroup.lean:255`: `theorem isOpen_mono [SeparatelyContinuousMul G] {H₁ H₂ : Subgroup G} (h : H₁ ≤ H₂) (h₁ : IsOpen (H₁ : Set G)) : IsOpen (H₂ : Set G)` under `variable {G : Type*} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G]`, `@[to_additive]`. `Mathlib/Topology/Algebra/Group/Defs.lean:100-101`: `class IsTopologicalAddGroup ... extends ContinuousAdd G, ContinuousNeg G`.
findings.fix: Replace `[IsTopologicalAddGroup B]` with `[SeparatelyContinuousAdd B]` on line 52 and adjust the two docstrings to say separate continuity of addition.
findings.issue: `isOpen_integralClosure_toSubring` assumes `[IsTopologicalAddGroup B]`; its sole dependency `AddSubgroup.isOpen_mono` needs only `[SeparatelyContinuousAdd B]`, so `ContinuousNeg B` is visibly unused and `ContinuousAdd B` is stronger than required. The docstring at line 55 ("Only the additive topological group structure of `B` is used") and module docstring line 17 overstate what is needed.

summary: Two public declarations carry assumptions stronger than their proofs use: the two `topologicalClosure_map_coeRingHom` lemmas are trapped under `[CommRing A]` although nothing in them touches commutativity, and `isOpen_integralClosure_toSubring` demands `[IsTopologicalAddGroup B]` where only separate continuity of addition is used.
